verdict.rationale: Groq's billing FAQ documents first-party "Spend Limits" that let you set automated spending limits and receive budget alerts, which covers both the cap and alert halves of the story. This feature is unlocked on upgrading to a paid tier. The documentation is only a brief FAQ line, so how the cap actually behaves is unclear. missing for 10: details on whether limits hard-stop API requests once reached, alert threshold configuration and delivery channels, per-project or per-key granularity, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
